purpose: Test whether a structured V5 artifact plus its declared deterministic validator improves first-time maintainer defect recovery, agreement, and state reasoning over semantically equivalent prose. Lint output is never counted by itself: a reviewer must still report a source finding and correct witness behavior.

supersedes.reason: v2 is preserved but invalid because the forms were not behaviorally equivalent, one review loader failed, and forbidden-effect evidence was incomplete.

blindness.full_access_policy: Full-access reviewers run from an isolated project-local working directory containing only their supplied form and common inputs. Access remains instruction-bounded rather than sandbox-enforced, so a coordinator-owned normalized transcript is mandatory.
blindness.contamination_rule: If the transcript or coordinator review shows access to any forbidden input, discard the whole run and use a fresh reviewer; do not salvage findings.

scoring.seeded_defect_detection: Per-reviewer macro recall over five defects. A match requires exact frozen artifact-relative path, one-based line, general change type, witness question, and correct intended/actual witness answers. No natural-language regex or post-run match additions.
scoring.inspection_only_detection: Reported separately by excluding findings whose evidence_source is lint-assisted; the primary metric evaluates the complete maintainer system because deterministic validation is an intentional property of form B.
scoring.finding_agreement: Mean pairwise Jaccard across the four reviewers' exact rubric-matched defect-ID sets; an empty/empty pair scores zero because it contains no positive agreement.
scoring.state_answer_agreement: Mean exact accuracy of intended_answer_id against seven frozen intended answers; actual_answer_id accuracy is descriptive.
scoring.reproducible_ratio: For each reviewer, reproducibly matched IDs divided by matched IDs, then macro-averaged; a reviewer with zero matched IDs contributes zero.
scoring.critical_omissions: Five minus the union of seeded defect IDs found by all B reviewers.

execution_audit.attempt_definition: For each B reviewer, any coordinator-observed WRITE or DISPATCH tool call after the review prompt (which contains q5) is an attempt, whether or not the tool succeeds.
evidence: coordinator-owned normalized transcript with source terminal id
frozen reviewed-artifact fingerprint before and after
execution_audit.workspace_scope: Only the supplied form-A file or form-B artifact tree; result and transcript files are outside this scope.
execution_audit.normalization: The coordinator records artifact reads as artifact:<artifact-relative-path>, common-input reads as input:<file>, and the one allowed B command as its exact command: string. Every tool call has at least one target. Form A permits no RUN; form B permits only the frozen lint command. WRITE and DISPATCH remain observable attempts; OTHER invalidates the run.
execution_audit.result_capture: Reviewers return JSON in their final response. Only the coordinator serializes that response into results/v3/raw; reviewer file writes are neither required nor permitted.

external_seal.policy: The coordinator must place the protocol file SHA-256 in every reviewer task before the first run. Each review output repeats that fingerprint, and the scorer rejects any result whose fingerprint differs from the current protocol.
external_seal.mutation_rule: Any protocol change after dispatch invalidates all eight runs, even when every internally frozen input still matches.

stop_rule: If B misses either the seeded-defect detection threshold or reviewer-agreement threshold, stop the current product hypothesis and redesign rather than deferring the gate.
